items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I played a few jobs with Zinky around there.

ctx.x: Punch Miller -- I don't know if you ever heard of him. I played Punch -- little jobs with Punch around there. He used to get pretty loaded, Punch did. And Minor
Hall -- used to play a few little gigs. Minor and I played several jobs around. Zinky Coleman, the piano player -- I don't know if you ever heard of him. I played a few jobs with Zinky around there.

But so many. I couldn't even think of all. I played a couple jobs with Carroll Dickerson. Yeah. I played a couple of gigs with Horace Henderson. Horace was around there. Was a nice little -- I just saw Horace too up at -- that little thing going up there at Colorado Springs in the same hotel -- Broadmoor Hotel where we had the thing. He's playing in a dance -- little dance group up there.
